verdict.rationale: Featurebase's marketing says outright that you can 'Build workflows for SLAs, automatically extending trials, offering discounts,' which matches the story. Its developer docs show webhooks that react to user feedback, conversation activity and status changes, with signature verification and automatic retries. However, the workflow capability rests on a single marketing line with no builder documentation. Missing for 10: documentation of the workflow builder and its triggers, explicit evidence that workflows can be triggered natively by feedback events (as opposed to webhooks handled by your own backend), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
